Enemy appearance mn_ff2_002_c00.en: A thorny plant creature curls long tendrils around a pointed central head. A slanted eye and an open, toothed jaw show among the coils. It has purple tendrils and gold thorns.

Enemy appearance mn_ff2_002_c01.en: A thorny plant creature curls long tendrils around a pointed central head. A slanted eye and an open, toothed jaw show among the coils. It has green tendrils, orange thorns and red and yellow accents around the mouth.

Enemy appearance mn_ff2_003_c00.en: A flying insect with large compound eyes, bent legs, broad raised wings and a striped abdomen tapering to a stinger. It has a green-black body, coral wings and yellow stinger.

Enemy appearance mn_ff2_003_c01.en: A flying insect with large compound eyes, bent legs, broad raised wings and a striped abdomen tapering to a stinger. It has a violet body, orange-and-violet bands, orange wings and a pink stinger.

Enemy appearance mn_ff2_004_c00.en: A shaggy, crouched ape-like creature with a low face, a bared mouth, long arms, thick legs and heavy clawed hands and feet. It is icy white and blue with a purple face and claws.

Enemy appearance mn_ff2_004_c01.en: A shaggy, crouched ape-like creature with a low face, a bared mouth, long arms, thick legs and heavy clawed hands and feet. It is sandy brown with dark facial shading and green claw tips.

Enemy appearance mn_ff2_005_c00.en: An upright cluster of jagged spikes frames a narrow face with a small open mouth. Long points taper below it and two curved spikes rise above. It is steel blue with a red mouth.

Enemy appearance mn_ff2_006_c00.en: A long-legged bird with a lowered head, prominent eye, hooked beak and ragged wings. Two thin legs extend downward to open toes. It is blue-gray with a crimson eye and a pale beak.

Enemy appearance mn_ff2_007_c00.en: A bulky turtle with a long broad reptilian head, thick legs and large claws. Large spikes rise from its shell. It is olive green with a tan shell and reddish claws.

Enemy appearance mn_ff2_018_c00.en: An upright, snarling fish has a broad mouth, sharp teeth and a strong fan of pointed fins running along its head and back. A forked tail hangs below. It is orange with cobalt and pale fins.

Enemy appearance mn_ff2_050_c00.en: A bulky blue-armored giant with a narrow red eye slit, horned helmet, layered shoulder plates and wide armored boots. It holds an enormous curved pale green blade across its waist.

Enemy appearance mn_ff2_051_c00.en: A massive orange-gold dragon has several long necks ending in horned toothy heads. Its spread batlike wings are edged in dark brown. A heavy scaled tail curls behind its crouched body and clawed feet.
Enemy appearance mn_ff2_051_c00.ja: 黄金がかった橙色の巨大な竜。何本もの長い首の先に、角と歯を持つ頭がある。広げたコウモリのような翼は濃茶色で縁取られ、身を低くした胴と爪のある足の後ろで、鱗のある太い尾が巻く。

Enemy appearance mn_ff2_052_c00.en: A wide-winged purple insect with a broad face, orange eye and mouth accents, layered armor and pale hooked wing tips. Slender segmented parts hang from the dark central body.
Enemy appearance mn_ff2_052_c00.ja: 紫の虫が大きく翼を広げる。幅広い顔に橙色の目と口元があり、層になった外殻と先が鉤形に曲がった淡い翼が見える。暗い胴から節のある細い突起が垂れる。

Enemy appearance mn_ff2_053_c00.en: A muscular green and gold humanoid with a horned head and broad pairs of pale blue feathered wings. Its bent arms hold a long gold spear across its body. One leg bends beneath the waist.
Enemy appearance mn_ff2_053_c00.ja: 緑と金の筋肉質な人型。角のある頭と、淡青色の羽毛に覆われた幅広い翼を何枚も持つ。両腕を曲げて長い金色の槍を体の前に構え、片脚を腰の下で曲げる。

Enemy appearance mn_ff2_054_c00.en: A floating gold-armored figure with a spiked crownlike headpiece, narrow eyes and bright layered chest and shoulder plates. Red cape panels and long gold tassels flare below. One clawed hand grips a long violet tridentlike staff.
Enemy appearance mn_ff2_054_c00.ja: 金色の鎧を着けた人型が浮かぶ。とげのある冠のような頭飾りに細い目、明るく重なった胸当てと肩当てがある。赤いマントと長い金色の房が下に広がり、爪のある手で紫色の三つ又の長い杖を握る。
